_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Falling-to-sideways coil inside 32-38 with no proven breaker; THIN calendar leans and skew-at-extremes do not justify leaving Denial or forcing UP/DOWN.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst HOLD/CAUTION in Denial; narrative accumulation-bottom bias implies constructive recovery without an explicit phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: Phase score stays 32-38 and BTC holds the recent range next session without a trend day or funding flip
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding goes negative on a range break lower (slip toward Panic) or sustained ETF/liquidity bid lifts score into Anxiety
